---
title: "Sprott F System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& -y+z \\
\dot{y} &=& x+ay \\
\dot{z} &=& x^2-z
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=0.5$ and initial condition $(-1,2,3)$.
